name: AirTrunk JHB2
summary: JHB2 is AirTrunk's second hyperscale campus in Malaysia, announced in February 2025 in Iskandar Puteri, Johor, and scalable to more than 270 MW on a site of over 11 hectares. It is designed for high-density AI loads with liquid cooling and a grid connection from Tenaga Nasional Berhad on an accelerated schedule, with AirTrunk providing land for a new substation. In April 2026 AirTrunk said JHB1 and JHB2 were almost fully contracted, and in July 2026 it secured US$2.325 billion of green project financing for JHB2. The cited sources give no opening date.

location.note: AirTrunk names Iskandar Puteri without an address; coordinates are the OpenStreetMap Nominatim centroid of Iskandar Puteri.

parties.name: Tenaga Nasional Berhad
parties.note: Providing the grid connection under its Green Lane Pathway; AirTrunk is providing land for a new TNB substation.

metrics.note: AirTrunk's facility page calls this total capacity without saying whether it is IT load. AirTrunk separately gives more than 420 MW of IT load across JHB1 and JHB2 combined.

milestones.note: AirTrunk said the announcement brought its Malaysia investment to RM 9.7 billion, without a JHB2-specific figure.
AirTrunk said JHB1 and JHB2 were almost 100% contracted.
US$2.325 billion (RM 9.5 billion) green project financing from 30 lenders including IFC secured to support JHB2's development.

power_sources.description: Grid connection from Tenaga Nasional Berhad, targeted on an accelerated 12-month timeframe.
